The [[tractor beam power-generator trench]] was one of seven locations where [[Docking Bay 327/Legends|Docking Bay 327's]] [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]] was connected to the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star I's]] [[Reactor/Legends|reactor]]. The [[Level 6 Core Shaft Corridor]] within the trench, more specifically [[Tractor Beam 12/Legends|Tractor Beam 12]] of zone [[N6]], was where [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] severed the connection, allowing the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] to escape. The entry area to the corridor was guarded by two [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], but Kenobi distracted them with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].
